translationRepairs: In the eighth month on jiawu the death testament reached the capital and the imperial great-grandson was sent to meet the bier at Kaiping.
In the eighth month on jiachen the death testament reached the capital and the imperial great-grandson was sent to meet the bier at Kaiping.
s0039 has 八月甲辰; 甲辰 is jiachen, while jiawu is 甲午, so the idiomatic day name must be corrected.
In the eighth month on jiawu the final edict arrived; the imperial great-grandson was dispatched to receive the coffin at Kaiping.
In the eighth month on jiachen the final edict arrived; the imperial great-grandson was dispatched to receive the coffin at Kaiping.
The same 八月甲辰 requires literal jiachen rather than jiawu; the rest of the sentence already matches 遺詔至，遣皇太孫迎喪開平.
On disi he ascended the throne.
On dingsi he ascended the throne.
s0041 opens with 丁巳; the sexagenary reading is dingsi, and disi is a malformed romanization of that day.
On disi he assumed the imperial throne.
On dingsi he assumed the imperial throne.
Literal English likewise misreads 丁巳 as disi; dingsi restores the correct day name without changing the accession wording.
On jiwei an edict required civil officials to retire at seventy.
On jisi an edict required civil officials to retire at seventy.
s0052 has 己巳; that day is jisi, whereas jiwei is 己未, so the idiomatic date is wrong.
On jiwei an edict fixed retirement at seventy for civil officials.
On jisi an edict fixed retirement at seventy for civil officials.
The literal field repeats the same 己巳→jiwei error; jisi matches the Chinese day name.
On bingyin Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu crushed the rebels of Pingyao and Xunzhou.
On bingyin Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu crushed the rebels of Pingle and Xunzhou.
s0098 has 平樂、潯州蠻; 平樂 is Pingle, not Pingyao (平遙), so the place name in the idiomatic must change.
On bingyin Gu Xingzu Marquis of Zhenyuan broke the Pingyao and Xunzhou tribes.
On bingyin Gu Xingzu Marquis of Zhenyuan broke the Pingle and Xunzhou tribes.
Literal English likewise turns 平樂 into Pingyao; Pingle restores the Guangxi place named in the Chinese.
